# CORPUS COMPLETENESS

*Generated by `scripts/ingest/search/corpus-completeness.ts`. Companion to
`CORPUS_REACHABILITY.md`, which answers a different question.*

**Reachability asks whether a query can select a collection. Completeness asks whether
the collection contains the documents it claims to cover.** A collection can be 100% of
the first and 60% of the second and every dashboard we had would call it healthy.

Collections: **74** — reconciled against the publisher **6**, confirmed section target only **52**, **NOT RECONCILED 16**.

⚠ **NOT RECONCILED does not mean incomplete. It means unmeasured** — nobody has compared
this collection against its publisher's own list. Read it as a gap in the instrument,
not a gap in the corpus, and do not quote a coverage figure for these rows.

## How a collection moves out of NOT RECONCILED

Walk the publisher's own enumeration and record what it publishes, per unit, then diff
against what `corpus_sections` holds. For legislation.gov.uk that is
`scripts/ingest/v36-source-census.ts --enumerate` followed by `v36-reconcile.ts`.
For other publishers the walk differs; the requirement does not. **A count of what we
fetched is not a denominator** — the V34 Commons enumerator would have reported success
having ingested 25 of 2,361 rows.
